what: seven earlier runs of the Dormand-Prince code of src/physics.js (version 0.2.33: its source files with only the constants of the corrector tolerance and of the integrator tolerances turned into settings whose defaults are the original values; the run files record the settings that were used), each following one family in one direction of lam from a start orbit until it lost the family. tolerance: the corrector tolerance, 1e-11 (the default) or 1e-10 (one declared variant). dp45_settings: "default", or the tighter integrator tolerances that were used for a14 +. n: number of recorded points. why: the reason the trace ended, as stored. end_d: the closest approach of the tool at the last point, where the trace lost the family (a tool value, not witnessed). endx: the closest approach where the reliable stretch of the trace ended as read then: the points before the first one whose tool closure was 1e-6 or more or whose multiple precision witness closure was 1e-6 or more; it equals end_d where no point failed and is larger where one did (t19 -, t35 + and a14 + at 1e-10).

runs.label: a14 +
runs.dp45_settings: tighter: rtol 1e-14, atol 1e-15, hMax 0.002, monodromy rtol 1e-13, atol 1e-14
